opportunity_axes.five_means: Materially improves a frequent or consequential user outcome.
Materially reduces false assurance, unsafe change, security, privacy, or delivery risk.
Authoritative, representative, privacy-safe evidence and fixtures are already accessible.
Unlocks multiple domains, personas, channels, or future capabilities.
Requires the largest architecture, data, test, UX, and maintenance effort.
Introduces the greatest runtime, credential, external-system, or human-process risk.
Need, evidence, feasibility, or acceptance is least certain.

opportunity_portfolio.ranking_rule: No hidden or aggregate score is computed. Axis values are discussion inputs; dependencies, safety gates, and human priorities decide sequencing.

items.title: Complete capability dossiers and relationship traversal
items.axis_notes: Search, filters, provenance, gap links, table output, and URL-bound filter state already ship; the remaining value is stable per-ID dossiers and bidirectional relationship navigation.

items.title: Turn unknown parser and coverage signals into roadmap evidence
items.axis_notes: It strengthens honesty across every domain without expanding device access.

items.title: Deepen protocol support through a stage matrix
items.axis_notes: The current seven-family health model provides a concrete starting denominator.

items.title: Build an authoritative stateful flow and policy engine
items.axis_notes: High value and reach, but vendor semantics and return-path/NAT proof make it a major program.

items.title: Add a bounded multi-signal observability spine
items.axis_notes: Continuous collection changes storage, privacy, performance, and operational boundaries.

items.title: Create a vendor-neutral cloud and Kubernetes profile
items.axis_notes: Strategic breadth is large, so profile scope must be tightly staged.

items.title: Extend fixture-first read-only collection beyond APIC, vManage, ISE, and FMC
items.axis_notes: The four shipped controller collectors provide reusable safety patterns; every additional live credential and API-drift surface still requires demand evidence, quarantined collection, fixtures, and lab validation.

items.title: Bind advisories, SBOM, applicability, and provenance
items.axis_notes: Exact applicability is more valuable than broad unauthenticated matching.

items.title: Promote tokens into a complete white-label pack
items.axis_notes: Existing owners reduce implementation uncertainty; localization broadens the later scope.

items.title: Connect findings to services, SLOs, and value ranges
items.axis_notes: The model is valuable only when customer-owned service and financial assumptions are available.

items.title: Deliver fourteen deterministic advisory labs
items.axis_notes: Synthetic fixtures make this low-risk, provided labs never become support proof.

items.title: Research a passive, safety-first OT profile
items.axis_notes: Safety and vertical variation demand expert review and lab evidence before promotion.

items.title: Research service-provider profile families
items.axis_notes: The target buyer and profile must be chosen before a meaningful implementation denominator exists.

items.title: Choose product deployment, tenancy, and commercial boundary
items.axis_notes: This human decision changes every security, hosting, support, and roadmap assumption; engineering should not infer it.

decision_queue.title: Which deployment and commercial boundary is the target?
decision_queue.current_recommendation: Preserve the proven offline field mode while selecting one additional target explicitly; do not let SaaS obligations appear accidentally.

decision_queue.title: Which domain expansion should receive the next implementation denominator?
decision_queue.authority: human product owner and architecture lead
decision_queue.current_recommendation: Prioritize stateful traffic plus unknown-signal governance because both strengthen existing users before expanding into unrelated estates.

decision_queue.title: Should Atlas remain snapshot-first or add continuous telemetry?
decision_queue.authority: human product, security, privacy, and operations owners
decision_queue.current_recommendation: Start with replayable customer-exported telemetry and local ephemeral analysis; defer an Atlas-managed store until privacy, cost, tenancy, and SLO needs are proven.

decision_queue.title: What is the first authoritative stateful-flow scope?
decision_queue.current_recommendation: Define a vendor-neutral intermediate representation, prove it first with a bounded Cisco ACL/firewall/NAT slice, and label unsupported semantics unknown.

decision_queue.title: Is white-labeling build-time, deployment-time, or tenant-time?
decision_queue.current_recommendation: Use a versioned deployment-time brand pack first; runtime tenant branding creates authentication and tenancy dependencies.

decision_queue.title: Which external sources may influence findings, and at what authority?
decision_queue.current_recommendation: Keep all watch sources horizon/advisory until a source-specific provenance, applicability, freshness, and test contract is promoted.

decision_queue.title: What data may interactive labs use?
decision_queue.current_recommendation: Ship repository-owned synthetic fixtures first; treat any field-derived fixture as a separate privacy and licensing decision.

decision_queue.title: Which external integration becomes the first supported contract?
decision_queue.current_recommendation: Choose a read-only import or proposed-ticket/export workflow whose source authority is unambiguous; avoid two-way synchronization first.

decision_queue.title: Should the private master reference be published publicly?
decision_queue.current_recommendation: Remain private until legal, threat, privacy, source-use, and content-owner review explicitly clears a public edition.

decision_queue.title: Which real outcomes may calibrate the product?
decision_queue.authority: human product, privacy, and quality owners
decision_queue.current_recommendation: Start with explicit artifact acceptance, finding confirmation, and cutover/PIR outcomes under existing data floors; do not infer avoided incidents or ROI.

invariants.statement: Atlas never writes a device; production change remains a human-owned PR and CAB action.
invariants.formal_rule: No engine, collector, reference, graph, or generated procedure may invoke a device-mutating operation or self-approve execution.
invariants.residual_risk: A newly added integration or external operator could introduce mutation outside currently scanned entry points.

invariants.statement: Repository sessions do not read or write the personal vault; only a separately produced sanitized one-way digest may be consumed.
invariants.formal_rule: Repository code and reference builds must not enumerate, read, copy, index, or write raw personal-vault content.
invariants.residual_risk: An owner-machine process outside this repository could violate the boundary before producing a purported digest.

invariants.statement: The engine and AST graph do not perform external network or cloud-model calls.
invariants.formal_rule: Analysis and Graphify execution paths must remain offline and may not call remote APIs, cloud models, telemetry endpoints, or analytics services.
invariants.residual_risk: Optional tools, dependencies, or future dynamic plugins can add network behavior unless kept outside the engine boundary and re-reviewed.

invariants.statement: Each shared fact has one authoritative owner; copies are labeled caches and reconciled.
invariants.formal_rule: Every shared fact ID resolves to exactly one canonical owner; every duplicate value declares cache status and a reconciliation rule.
invariants.residual_risk: A new local calculation can bypass the registry until census and reconciliation tests are extended.
invariants.independent_verifier: human SSOT maintainer independent of the fact author

invariants.statement: Absent, malformed, conflicting, unsupported, or unobserved evidence never silently becomes healthy.
invariants.formal_rule: A clean or healthy verdict requires observed valid evidence and its declared denominator; all other evidence states remain non-healthy and visible.
invariants.residual_risk: Untested parser shapes or new renderers can still coerce unknown values unless negative-state tests accompany them.

invariants.statement: Byte integrity never implies official authority, applicability, or freshness.
invariants.formal_rule: A valid digest may establish byte identity only; authority, scope, applicability, and freshness require separate explicit receipts.
invariants.residual_risk: A consumer outside controlled renderers can still misinterpret a digest as endorsement or applicability.

invariants.statement: Observed state, derived result, inference, recommendation, and future hypothesis remain visibly distinct.
invariants.formal_rule: Every consequential record declares its evidence class; renderers may not relabel inferred, advisory, synthetic, or future content as observed fact.
invariants.residual_risk: Human readers can overgeneralize a bounded label when downstream prose omits its scope.

invariants.statement: A consequential author or recommendation is independently verified.
invariants.formal_rule: For verified or published consequential work, author identity and verifier identity must both exist and must differ.
invariants.residual_risk: Nominally distinct identities may lack practical independence without human organizational review.
invariants.independent_verifier: human governance reviewer outside the proposing role

invariants.statement: Approval, execution, rollback, acceptance, and completion require their named human/evidence gates.
invariants.formal_rule: No later lifecycle state is entered unless every mandatory predecessor, human authority, and evidence receipt for that transition is valid and current.
invariants.residual_risk: External organizations can misstate an approval or receipt not cryptographically bound to this system.

invariants.statement: Input is bounded before expensive or ambiguous interpretation.
invariants.formal_rule: Traversal, link, type, size, depth, count, duplicate-key, and expansion limits are evaluated before parser or renderer work.
invariants.residual_risk: A newly supported container or parser can introduce an unmodeled expansion or ambiguity class.

invariants.statement: Custody binds the bytes actually supplied to the parser, not a separately reopened path.
invariants.formal_rule: Identity, bounds, digest, and parser input must derive from the same open read; mutation invalidates custody and dependent trust.
invariants.residual_risk: Filesystem or platform semantics outside tested hosts may expose mutation modes not recognized by current custody checks.

invariants.statement: Client-controlled content cannot mint a trusted or verified server label.
invariants.formal_rule: Uploaded fields representing verification, completion, provenance, authority, or trust are ignored or stripped until server-owned checks produce them.
invariants.residual_risk: A future route or renderer can accidentally trust an unfiltered field without sharing the server-owned projection.

invariants.statement: Artifacts are deterministic views of canonical truth, not parallel sources of truth.
invariants.formal_rule: Writers consume canonical snapshot fields and deterministic metadata; a rendered value may not become an independent canonical calculation.
invariants.residual_risk: Format-specific convenience logic can drift into duplicate canonical derivation without parity tests.

invariants.statement: The built archive and produced bytes, not only the checkout, are the release subject.
invariants.formal_rule: Release approval binds exact archive members, digests, source identity, manifest, and verification receipts; checkout-only success cannot publish.
invariants.residual_risk: An external hosting or transfer layer can alter bytes after repository release verification.

invariants.statement: Client evidence, likely identifiers, unsafe links, and unapproved payloads block repository/release verification.
invariants.formal_rule: Any prohibited client, vault, credential, identifier, unsafe-link, or payload finding makes repository and release privacy verdicts blocking.
invariants.residual_risk: Contextual identifiers or novel encodings may evade pattern-based scanning and require independent human review.

invariants.statement: The master reference does not ingest evidence, persist state, call a runtime API, set analytics, or become an SSOT.
invariants.formal_rule: The reference is a read-only exact-tree projection: no evidence upload, operational mutation, runtime fetch, analytics, cookie, or local persistence mechanism is permitted.
invariants.residual_risk: A future dependency or hosting wrapper can add runtime calls or persistence outside current source scans.
invariants.independent_verifier: human reference privacy and platform reviewer

invariants.statement: Training labs and external summaries are advisory-only and cannot change assessment truth or imply support.
invariants.formal_rule: Every lab and horizon record declares advisory role, no support claim, no truth mutation, and a bounded does-not-prove statement.
invariants.residual_risk: A reader may mistake a realistic synthetic walkthrough for implementation unless every surface preserves the disclaimer.

invariants.statement: Catalog denominator and schema changes are disclosed when comparing coverage over time.
invariants.formal_rule: Coverage comparisons bind catalog and schema versions; additions, removals, splits, and merges are scope evolution rather than hidden progress or regression.
invariants.residual_risk: Historical reports can be compared without an upcaster or denominator-delta view and thereby mislead readers.

invariants.statement: Opportunity axes remain visible and unblended; no hidden formula determines priorities.
invariants.formal_rule: Decision views expose every axis and note; they may not store or render a weighted, aggregate, hidden, or pseudo-objective ranking score.
invariants.residual_risk: Readers can still apply their own implicit weighting; Atlas must show sensitivity rather than claim neutrality.

invariants.statement: The closed Capability Catalog and Open Horizon Register remain separate; watch status is never rendered as current support.
invariants.formal_rule: A horizon signal can enter the closed catalog only through reviewed promotion with source, scope, owner, gap, tests, and denominator-version evidence.
invariants.residual_risk: A manual summary can overstate a watched technology unless it preserves advisory role and support_claim=none.

quality_scenarios.stimulus: An archive contains traversal, link, reparse, duplicate-key, oversized, or deeply nested input.
quality_scenarios.response: Reject the candidate before parsing and expose the bounded reason.
quality_scenarios.measure: Zero escaped writes and zero parser invocation for rejected input.

quality_scenarios.stimulus: A file is replaced, truncated, grown, or changed during collection.
quality_scenarios.response: Abort custody and withhold trusted evidence.
quality_scenarios.measure: Every mutation shape produces an incomplete/failed custody record.

quality_scenarios.stimulus: A command, axis, controller export, or prerequisite is absent.
quality_scenarios.measure: No positive-health claim without its coverage witness.

quality_scenarios.stimulus: Two observations disagree on a shared fact.
quality_scenarios.response: Preserve provenance, expose conflict, and block stronger dependent claims.
quality_scenarios.measure: Reconciliation reports a violation; no silent winner outside owner policy.

quality_scenarios.stimulus: A product ID does not exactly match authoritative lifecycle scope.
quality_scenarios.response: Return Unknown and omit a lifecycle claim.

quality_scenarios.stimulus: A controller redirects authentication/session traffic to HTTP or another host.
quality_scenarios.response: Refuse the redirect and transmit no credential/session to the destination.
quality_scenarios.measure: No downgrade or cross-host credential transmission.

quality_scenarios.stimulus: Uploaded JSON asserts verified provenance or completion.
quality_scenarios.response: Strip or ignore client-owned trust fields and stamp server-owned status only after verification.
quality_scenarios.measure: Client input cannot produce a trusted label.

quality_scenarios.stimulus: A writer returns, but one artifact is missing, empty, corrupt, or stale.
quality_scenarios.response: Mark the set short/failed and prevent complete status.
quality_scenarios.measure: Produced-versus-expected and structural validation identify the exact problem.

quality_scenarios.stimulus: The built wheel or source archive contains unexpected, missing, altered, or sensitive bytes.
quality_scenarios.measure: Exact inventory and digest comparison rejects the archive.

quality_scenarios.stimulus: The bounded synthetic forward and reverse path/ACL/MTU/ECMP dimensions pass, but NAT translation or firewall session policy fails.
quality_scenarios.response: Return a bounded failure/unknown with state, rule, translation, and path provenance; never promote the current synthetic verdict or L2 reachability into session success.
quality_scenarios.measure: Golden stateful and NAT fixtures plus independent lab evidence distinguish synthetic path assurance from session outcome.

quality_scenarios.stimulus: Signals use different clocks, sampling rates, and retention windows.
quality_scenarios.response: Expose time-quality uncertainty and decline causal ordering that exceeds it.
quality_scenarios.measure: Known skew and missing metadata prevent overconfident correlation.

quality_scenarios.stimulus: The largest declared catalog and representative large fleet are opened on a constrained field host.
quality_scenarios.response: Progressive disclosure, search, tables, and graph simplification remain responsive.
quality_scenarios.measure: Declared load, interaction, memory, and render budgets pass.

quality_scenarios.stimulus: A user operates every major journey without a pointer and with reduced motion.
quality_scenarios.response: Focus order, labels, state, alternatives, and no-motion feedback remain understandable.
quality_scenarios.measure: All catalog, graph, lab, and decision journeys complete from keyboard.

quality_scenarios.stimulus: A deployment changes identity, palette, terminology, and artifact furniture.
quality_scenarios.environment: Web, Explorer, portable, and Office outputs
quality_scenarios.response: One brand pack changes all intended surfaces without technical-owner drift.
quality_scenarios.measure: No stray identity or token literals; contrast and snapshot gates pass.

quality_scenarios.stimulus: A valid capture contains a new platform, protocol string, or response shape.
quality_scenarios.response: Preserve a sanitized unknown signal, avoid false health, and queue disposition.
quality_scenarios.measure: Every valid unmapped signal has a catalog/horizon/out-of-scope disposition.

quality_scenarios.stimulus: A watched standard becomes relevant and shipping in target estates.
quality_scenarios.response: Promote it only with source, scope, capability/gap, owner, tests, and denominator version in one reviewed change.
quality_scenarios.measure: No watch item appears as current support before all promotion criteria pass.

quality_scenarios.stimulus: A contributor attempts to add raw collection, credential, client identifier, or vault-derived content to the master reference.
quality_scenarios.response: Reject the content and retain only repository-owned generic metadata.
quality_scenarios.measure: Privacy gate and content review find zero prohibited material.

quality_scenarios.stimulus: The reference is opened without network access.
quality_scenarios.response: All core content, relationships, search, and labs remain available; external links are optional advisory exits.
quality_scenarios.measure: No runtime fetch, font, analytics, API, or CDN dependency.

labs.title: Evidence to Artifact
labs.objective: Trace one synthetic observation through bounded intake, same-read custody, canonical fact, analysis, gate, writer, manifest, and rendered artifact.
labs.interaction: Choose a declared evidence state and follow only owner-backed transitions; remove one prerequisite to see the downstream claim abstain.
labs.data_policy: Repository-owned synthetic identifiers and metadata only; no client capture, raw vault content, credential, or filesystem mutation.
labs.proves: The declared evidence-to-artifact contracts and owners for the demonstrated synthetic path.
labs.does_not_prove: That every parser, finding, writer, or field artifact has runtime evidence or human review.

expected_observations: failed prerequisites invalidate dependent claims
produced artifacts retain the manifest-bound source chain
deterministic_definition.reset_rule: Return to the repository-declared observed baseline; no state is persisted.
deterministic_definition.source_binding: Owner references resolve to tracked exact-tree paths; executable fixtures and answer-key receipts remain absent.

labs.title: Claim and Coverage Honesty
labs.objective: Distinguish observed, clean, finding, absent, malformed, conflicting, unsupported, unknown, synthetic, and field-validated claim states.
labs.interaction: Select evidence and denominator conditions, then compare the only verdicts allowed by the declared truth contract.
labs.data_policy: Synthetic claim metadata derived from repository-owned coverage and reconciliation contracts.
labs.proves: The declared claim-state algebra prevents absence or malformed evidence from silently becoming health.
labs.does_not_prove: Correctness of a detector outside the selected source, denominator, test, and evidence scope.

expected_observations: missing evidence never yields clean
synthetic coverage never renders as field validation
deterministic_definition.reset_rule: Restore every evidence and denominator selector to unknown before starting another case.
deterministic_definition.source_binding: The truth contract and coverage owners are tracked; no executable lab fixture or scored answer key is claimed.

labs.title: Protocol Intelligence
labs.objective: Compare collection, parsing, normalization, assessment, design advice, simulation, validation, and output maturity for a selected protocol family.
labs.interaction: Choose a protocol cell and walk its declared current scope, owner, traffic plane, gap, and acceptance obligations.
labs.data_policy: Catalog metadata and repository-owned generic protocol states only; no device or controller evidence.
labs.proves: The selected protocol's declared support boundary and unresolved stages in this catalog version.
labs.does_not_prove: Protocol correctness, release parity, interoperability, or field behavior beyond cited owners and fixtures.

deterministic_inputs: declared support state and gap references
expected_observations: catalog presence does not imply support
every incomplete protocol resolves to actionable acceptance evidence
deterministic_definition.reset_rule: Clear the selected capability and return to the complete protocol denominator.
deterministic_definition.source_binding: Protocol owners and gap records are exact-tree references; interactive protocol fixtures are future work.

labs.title: Traffic and Separate Flow Engines
labs.objective: Keep physical, L2, L3/FIB, overlay/VRF, stateless policy, stateful policy/NAT, application identity, and measured traffic conclusions separate.
labs.interaction: Toggle one plane at a time and compare the shipped bounded synthetic IPv4 TCP/UDP RIB/ACL/MTU/ECMP assurance slice with absent stateful session/NAT and measured-flow evidence.
labs.data_policy: Synthetic plane states only; no packet payload, flow export, active probe, or client topology.
labs.proves: The declared eight-plane distinction, the exact bounded scope of traffic_assurance/1, and why its favorable synthetic result cannot certify another plane.
labs.does_not_prove: An authoritative stateful session, NAT/PAT translation, runtime rule hit, application, packet, live-flow, performance, field-validation, or production outcome.

deterministic_inputs: one declared state per traffic plane
expected_observations: requested forward/return synthetic assurance does not prove a stateful session or NAT
modeled reachability does not prove measured performance or field behavior
deterministic_definition.reset_rule: Reset all eight planes to unknown; never carry a verdict between engines.
deterministic_definition.source_binding: Traffic-plane records and the executable Traffic Assurance owner are tracked; this advisory definition does not execute the engine, ingest field evidence, or expand traffic_assurance/1.

labs.title: Topology and Failure
labs.objective: Trace how a bounded physical/L2/L3 topology changes under a declared node, link, member, gateway, or evidence failure.
labs.interaction: Select a synthetic failure and compare reachable, partitioned, reconverged, shared-fate, and unknown outcomes.
labs.data_policy: Repository-owned generic topology identifiers only; no real site, address, hostname, or circuit data.
labs.proves: The bounded graph and failure concepts implemented for supported captured evidence.
labs.does_not_prove: Actual convergence time, optical or provider behavior, unobserved control-plane state, or a live outage forecast.

deterministic_inputs: single declared failure or unknown-evidence event
expected_observations: partitions remain distinct from reconvergence
unobserved backup state remains unknown
deterministic_definition.reset_rule: Restore the baseline graph and remove every injected failure before the next scenario.
deterministic_definition.source_binding: Topology analysis and Explorer owners are tracked; the lab has no executable scenario fixture yet.

labs.title: Enterprise-Pattern Comparison
labs.objective: Compare campus, branch, WAN, classic data center, VXLAN-EVPN, ACI, cloud, OT, provider, and other declared enterprise patterns across the same lifecycle stages.
labs.interaction: Select two design cells and compare Discover, Assess, Target, Migrate, Simulate, Validate, Operate, and Learn maturity without blending gaps.
labs.data_policy: Capability metadata and generic design questions only; no customer architecture or vendor-confidential design.
labs.proves: The catalog's declared breadth, asymmetry, owners, and gaps for the compared patterns.
labs.does_not_prove: Design equivalence, validated design compliance, scalability, field readiness, or vendor feature parity.

expected_observations: each stage retains its own support state
missing pattern depth remains visible instead of inheriting adjacent support
deterministic_definition.reset_rule: Clear both pattern selections and restore the closed design denominator.
deterministic_definition.source_binding: Architecture coverage and governance owners are tracked; no pattern simulator or validated-design corpus is embedded.

labs.title: Cutover, Rollback, NRFU, and PIR
labs.objective: Walk a synthetic change through prerequisites, approval, MOP, dry run, CAB, cutover, rollback trigger, NRFU, acceptance, PIR, and learning without collapsing states.
labs.interaction: Invalidate or stale one receipt and observe which later transitions and completion claims are forbidden.
labs.data_policy: Synthetic gate and artifact identifiers only; no execution instruction, credential, approval, or external system action.
labs.proves: The declared fail-closed migration and acceptance state machine for the demonstrated records.
labs.does_not_prove: Approval, execution safety, NRFU success, PIR outcome, or completion for a real change.

expected_observations: failed upstream gates invalidate downstream verification
PIR and genuine outcome remain distinct from execution completion
deterministic_definition.reset_rule: Return every gate to draft and remove all synthetic receipts.
deterministic_definition.source_binding: Workflow, web trust, writer, and manifest owners are tracked; the lab never grants change authority.

labs.title: Lifecycle Authority
labs.objective: Distinguish product identity, scoped lifecycle match, registry integrity, authority, applicability, freshness, and unknown status.
labs.interaction: Change a synthetic product identifier or authority receipt and observe when lifecycle claims must abstain.
labs.data_policy: Synthetic product identifiers and registry metadata only; no serial number, contract, customer inventory, or live advisory call.
labs.proves: The exact-match lifecycle and authority boundary implemented for supported registry records.
labs.does_not_prove: Entitlement, contract coverage, field replacement need, vulnerability applicability, or freshness beyond the selected registry.

deterministic_inputs: registry integrity, authority, and freshness states
expected_observations: broad-family inheritance is rejected
integrity alone never becomes authority or applicability
deterministic_definition.reset_rule: Clear the product match and authority state before selecting another registry case.
deterministic_definition.source_binding: Lifecycle, registry, and SSOT owners are tracked; no external entitlement or advisory system is queried.

labs.title: Custody, Redaction, and Privacy
labs.objective: Trace synthetic bytes through intake bounds, same-read custody, producer redaction, independent output verification, repository privacy, and release blocking.
labs.interaction: Inject a mutation, identifier, secret pattern, unsafe link, or unapproved payload class and follow the fail-closed disposition.
labs.data_policy: Only synthetic forbidden-content markers and metadata; never a real credential, client identifier, vault page, or capture.
labs.proves: The declared custody, redaction-verification, and repository privacy boundaries for supported artifact classes.
labs.does_not_prove: Universal secret detection, legal anonymization, safe publication, or absence of sensitive context in untested formats.

deterministic_inputs: synthetic redaction and repository privacy findings
expected_observations: mutated bytes cannot retain trusted custody
a privacy finding blocks release rather than being silently redacted by the reference
deterministic_definition.reset_rule: Remove every synthetic marker and return the artifact disposition to unverified.
deterministic_definition.source_binding: Custody, redaction, and repository privacy owners are tracked; prohibited source content is never embedded.

labs.title: SSOT and Freshness
labs.objective: Trace one shared fact through owner declaration, cached copies, reconciliation, conflict, freshness, transformation, invalidation, and downstream abstention.
labs.interaction: Change one synthetic cache value or freshness bound and inspect which dependent claims remain current, conflict, or become stale.
labs.data_policy: Synthetic canonical facts and timestamps only; no real fleet count, external source, or cached machine memory.
labs.proves: The declared one-owner, reconciliation, conflict, and freshness semantics for registered facts.
labs.does_not_prove: That every repository statement is already registered, temporally versioned, or runtime-reconciled.

expected_observations: unreconciled conflict has no silent winner
stale or transformed evidence invalidates stronger dependent claims
deterministic_definition.reset_rule: Restore the owner value, remove the cache conflict, and reset temporal fields to unknown.
deterministic_definition.source_binding: SSOT and manifest owners are tracked; the lab does not inspect platform memory or external state.

labs.title: Static-versus-Runtime Architecture
labs.objective: Compare declared architecture, static imports/calls, Graphify extraction, synthetic runtime trace, API/GUI/artifact lineage, and forbidden dependency rules.
labs.interaction: Classify a synthetic edge as static, runtime-only, expected dynamic, stale, forbidden, unsupported inference, or unresolved.
labs.data_policy: Repository-owned architecture and source metadata only; no runtime client evidence, network call, or dynamic code execution.
labs.proves: How Atlas keeps static inference distinct from runtime truth and requires disposition for unexplained consequential edges.
labs.does_not_prove: Runtime coverage, dynamic dispatch resolution, production behavior, Graphify semantic completeness, or cross-file edge completeness after an incremental rebuild; a full Graphify rebuild is required before relying on edge completeness.

deterministic_inputs: synthetic runtime and downstream lineage states
expected_observations: static inference never becomes runtime truth
forbidden or consequential unresolved edges remain blocking
deterministic_definition.reset_rule: Clear the edge classification and return all evidence modes to unresolved.
deterministic_definition.source_binding: Architecture, source, and engine owners are tracked; runtime-trace fixtures and conformance answer keys remain absent.

labs.title: Decision Sensitivity and Value of Information
labs.objective: Compare alternatives, visible value/risk/effort/uncertainty axes, decision sensitivity, and which missing evidence would most change a bounded recommendation.
labs.interaction: Vary one explicit axis or evidence assumption at a time; retain do-nothing and abstention as first-class alternatives.
labs.data_policy: Synthetic ordinal axes and evidence states only; no fabricated ROI, customer cost, probability, or hidden weighting.
labs.proves: The unblended decision-axis contract and a bounded explanation of which assumption drives the displayed alternative set.
labs.does_not_prove: Statistical value of information, financial return, optimal ranking, probability of success, or owner approval.

expected_observations: no hidden composite score selects a winner
a value-of-information claim abstains without a declared decision-changing model
deterministic_definition.reset_rule: Restore every axis and evidence assumption to its catalog value; no preference is persisted.
deterministic_definition.source_binding: Decision and governance content is tracked; no probabilistic VOI engine or field outcome dataset is claimed.

labs.title: Source Line to User Output
labs.objective: Traverse a safe source line to containing symbol, runtime phase, claim, GUI or artifact consumer, test linkage, and known impact while preserving unresolved fields.
labs.interaction: Select a stable line record and follow only emitted relationships; stop and display uncertainty when a linkage is absent.
labs.data_policy: Safe tracked source projection only; restricted files remain opaque and no raw client or vault content is exposed.
labs.proves: Structural source binding and the emitted relationship chain for the selected exact-tree line.
labs.does_not_prove: Behavioral correctness, runtime execution, complete call resolution, field impact, or Level-4 human review.

deterministic_inputs: emitted symbol, claim, test, and downstream relationship IDs
expected_observations: missing relationships remain explicit unresolved fields
the selected line and every resolved target share the declared source binding
deterministic_definition.reset_rule: Clear the selected line and all relationship filters; no source text is cached by the lab.
deterministic_definition.source_binding: The source compiler and manifest bind records to the tracked tree; an executable traversal fixture and answer key remain absent.

labs.title: White-Label Propagation
labs.objective: Trace product identity, assets, tokens, terminology, artifact furniture, feature profile, locale, legal/support text, and accessibility checks across declared surfaces.
labs.interaction: Select a generic non-client brand-pack field and identify every declared web, portable, document, presentation, and support-text consumer plus any unpropagated gap.
labs.data_policy: Repository-owned generic theme metadata only; no customer profile, trademark asset, legal text, deployment secret, or tenant data.
labs.proves: The currently owned identity/token surfaces and the explicitly missing white-label propagation obligations.
labs.does_not_prove: A complete brand pack, localization/RTL readiness, legal approval, accessibility conformance, or customer-specific theme safety.

expected_observations: one owned token source is distinguished from ungoverned copies
unimplemented locale, legal, artifact, or accessibility propagation remains visible
deterministic_definition.reset_rule: Restore the default generic identity and remove every preview-only theme selection.
deterministic_definition.source_binding: Brand, Explorer, deliverable, and reference owners are tracked; no customer-specific profile is embedded.
